items.question: Trong câu "A software prototype is a partial, possibly crude, implementation of a proposed system.", từ "crude" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A software prototype is a partial, possibly crude, implementation of a proposed system.", what does "crude" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: crude /kruːd/ (tính từ): thô sơ, chưa hoàn thiện. "A crude prototype" là bản mẫu làm nhanh, chưa trau chuốt; nghĩa khác: "crude joke" = câu đùa thô tục.
items.explanationEn: crude /kruːd/ (adjective): rough and unfinished. "A crude prototype" is quickly made and unpolished; another sense: "a crude joke" is a rude one.

items.question: Trong câu "It turns abstract requirements into something tangible that users can see, touch, and react to.", từ "tangible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It turns abstract requirements into something tangible that users can see, touch, and react to.", what does "tangible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tangible /ˈtæn.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): hữu hình, cụ thể. Thường đối lập với "abstract"; cụm hay gặp: "tangible results" = kết quả cụ thể, thấy được.
items.explanationEn: tangible /ˈtæn.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): real and touchable. Often the opposite of "abstract"; common collocation: "tangible results" = results you can clearly see.

items.question: Trong câu "Prototypes surface missing, wrong, and ambiguous requirements that neither the BA nor the users noticed while reading text.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prototypes surface missing, wrong, and ambiguous requirements that neither the BA nor the users noticed while reading text.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
options: phủ lớp mặt, rải mặt đường
làm lộ ra, đưa ra ánh sáng
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, đưa ra ánh sáng. Khi là động từ, "surface a problem" = làm cho vấn đề lộ ra; khi là danh từ nghĩa là "bề mặt".
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to bring to light. As a verb, "surface a problem" means to make it visible; as a noun it means the outer layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Prototypes surface missing, wrong, and ambiguous requirements that neither the BA nor the users noticed while reading text.", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prototypes surface missing, wrong, and ambiguous requirements that neither the BA nor the users noticed while reading text.", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, hiểu nhiều cách. "Ambiguous requirements" là yêu cầu có thể hiểu theo nhiều cách; danh từ là "ambiguity".
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (adjective): open to several meanings. "Ambiguous requirements" can be read in more than one way; the noun is "ambiguity".

items.question: Trong câu "When you are unsure whether a technical approach is feasible, a small prototype can answer that question before you build the whole system on a false assumption.", từ "feasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you are unsure whether a technical approach is feasible, a small prototype can answer that question before you build the whole system on a false assumption.", what does "feasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: feasible /ˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): khả thi, làm được. Danh từ "feasibility" rất hay gặp: "technical feasibility" = tính khả thi về kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: feasible /ˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): possible to do. The noun "feasibility" is common: "technical feasibility" = whether it can technically be done.

items.question: Trong câu "When you are unsure whether a technical approach is feasible, a small prototype can answer that question before you build the whole system on a false assumption.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you are unsure whether a technical approach is feasible, a small prototype can answer that question before you build the whole system on a false assumption.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
options: giả định, điều cho là đúng
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định, điều cho là đúng. "Make an assumption" = đưa ra giả định; "a false assumption" = giả định sai.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): a belief taken without proof. "Make an assumption" = to suppose something; "a false assumption" is a wrong one.

items.question: Trong câu "Users cannot articulate their needs", từ "articulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users cannot articulate their needs", what does "articulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: articulate /ɑːˈtɪk.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): diễn đạt rõ ràng. "Articulate needs/ideas" = nói ra rõ ràng nhu cầu/ý tưởng; tính từ "articulate" = ăn nói lưu loát.
items.explanationEn: articulate /ɑːˈtɪk.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to express clearly. "Articulate needs or ideas" = put them clearly into words; the adjective means fluent and clear.

items.question: Trong câu "The first is scope: does the prototype cover breadth or depth?", từ "breadth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first is scope: does the prototype cover breadth or depth?", what does "breadth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: breadth /bredθ/ (danh từ): bề rộng, phạm vi. Cặp "breadth and depth" = bề rộng và chiều sâu; đừng nhầm với "breath" (hơi thở).
items.explanationEn: breadth /bredθ/ (noun): width, wide range. The pair "breadth and depth" is common; do not confuse it with "breath".

items.question: Trong câu "It is broad but shallow.", từ "shallow" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is broad but shallow.", what does "shallow" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: shallow /ˈʃæl.əʊ/ (tính từ): nông, không sâu. "Broad but shallow" = rộng nhưng nông; nghĩa bóng: "shallow understanding" = hiểu hời hợt.
items.explanationEn: shallow /ˈʃæl.əʊ/ (adjective): not deep. "Broad but shallow" = wide but not deep; figuratively, "shallow understanding" is superficial.

items.question: Trong câu "Displayed data is fake and hard-coded, not from a real database.", từ "hard-coded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Displayed data is fake and hard-coded, not from a real database.", what does "hard-coded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hard-coded /ˌhɑːdˈkəʊ.dɪd/ (tính từ): gán cứng trong mã. "Hard-coded values" là giá trị viết thẳng trong mã nguồn, không lấy từ cấu hình hay cơ sở dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: hard-coded /ˌhɑːdˈkəʊ.dɪd/ (adjective): fixed directly in code. "Hard-coded values" are written straight into source code instead of coming from config or a database.

items.question: Trong câu "A vertical prototype implements a narrow slice of functionality FULLY — from the interface through every layer down to the database.", từ "slice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A vertical prototype implements a narrow slice of functionality FULLY — from the interface through every layer down to the database.", what does "slice" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: slice /slaɪs/ (danh từ): một phần, lát cắt. "A slice of functionality" = một phần chức năng; "vertical slice" = lát cắt xuyên qua mọi tầng.
items.explanationEn: slice /slaɪs/ (noun): a portion or part. "A slice of functionality" is one part of it; a "vertical slice" cuts through every layer.

items.question: Trong câu "When to use it: to explore and clarify functional requirements and user task flows, and to evaluate usability.", từ "usability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When to use it: to explore and clarify functional requirements and user task flows, and to evaluate usability.", what does "usability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: usability /ˌjuː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính dễ sử dụng. "Usability testing" = kiểm thử tính dễ dùng với người dùng thật.
items.explanationEn: usability /ˌjuː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ease of use. "Usability testing" means checking ease of use with real users.

items.question: Trong câu "Users can navigate through screens, see layouts, labels, and buttons.", từ "navigate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users can navigate through screens, see layouts, labels, and buttons.", what does "navigate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: navigate /ˈnæv.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): di chuyển, điều hướng. "Navigate through screens/a site" = di chuyển giữa các màn hình/trang; danh từ "navigation".
items.explanationEn: navigate /ˈnæv.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to move around within. "Navigate through screens or a site" = move between them; the noun is "navigation".

items.question: Trong câu "A throwaway prototype is built with the EXPLICIT INTENT of discarding it once it has done its job of answering a question.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A throwaway prototype is built with the EXPLICIT INTENT of discarding it once it has done its job of answering a question.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (động từ): loại bỏ, vứt đi. "Discard a draft/prototype" = bỏ đi bản nháp/bản mẫu khi không còn cần.
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to throw away. "Discard a draft or prototype" = get rid of it once it is no longer needed.

items.question: Trong câu "A throwaway prototype is built with the EXPLICIT INTENT of discarding it once it has done its job of answering a question.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A throwaway prototype is built with the EXPLICIT INTENT of discarding it once it has done its job of answering a question.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, nói thẳng ra. Trái nghĩa với "implicit" (ngầm); "explicit permission" = sự cho phép rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated. The opposite of "implicit"; "explicit permission" is permission clearly given.

items.question: Trong câu "A throwaway prototype is built with the EXPLICIT INTENT of discarding it once it has done its job of answering a question.", từ "intent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A throwaway prototype is built with the EXPLICIT INTENT of discarding it once it has done its job of answering a question.", what does "intent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (danh từ): ý định, mục đích. "With the intent of doing something" = với ý định làm việc gì.
items.explanationEn: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (noun): purpose, aim. "With the intent of doing something" = with the purpose of doing it.

items.question: Trong câu "Skips error handling, validation, security, performance, and maintainability.", từ "maintainability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Skips error handling, validation, security, performance, and maintainability.", what does "maintainability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: maintainability /meɪnˌteɪ.nəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng bảo trì. Là một yêu cầu phi chức năng: mã dễ sửa, dễ hiểu, dễ nâng cấp về sau.
items.explanationEn: maintainability /meɪnˌteɪ.nəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ease of maintenance. A non-functional quality: code that is easy to fix, understand, and change later.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements are vague, incomplete, or contradictory.", từ "contradictory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements are vague, incomplete, or contradictory.", what does "contradictory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contradictory /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪk.tər.i/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. "Contradictory requirements" = các yêu cầu mâu thuẫn; động từ "contradict".
items.explanationEn: contradictory /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪk.tər.i/ (adjective): conflicting. "Contradictory requirements" conflict with each other; the verb is "contradict".

items.question: Trong câu "But the prototype was built with no error handling, no data validation, no security, no performance consideration, and messy code written in a hurry.", từ "in a hurry" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But the prototype was built with no error handling, no data validation, no security, no performance consideration, and messy code written in a hurry.", what does "in a hurry" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in a hurry /ɪn ə ˈhʌr.i/ (cụm từ): vội vàng, gấp gáp. "Written in a hurry" = viết vội; "be in a hurry" = đang vội.
items.explanationEn: in a hurry /ɪn ə ˈhʌr.i/ (phrase): hastily. "Written in a hurry" = written hastily; "be in a hurry" = be rushing.

items.question: Trong câu "The result: a fragile product the team will be propping up for years.", từ "fragile" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result: a fragile product the team will be propping up for years.", what does "fragile" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fragile /ˈfrædʒ.aɪl/ (tính từ): dễ vỡ, mong manh. Trong phần mềm, "fragile code" là mã dễ hỏng khi thay đổi nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: fragile /ˈfrædʒ.aɪl/ (adjective): easily broken. In software, "fragile code" breaks easily when something small changes.

items.question: Trong câu "The result: a fragile product the team will be propping up for years.", từ "prop up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result: a fragile product the team will be propping up for years.", what does "prop up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: prop up /prɒp ʌp/ (cụm từ): chống đỡ, duy trì. "Prop up" = chống đỡ cho thứ yếu ớt khỏi sụp, thường mang nghĩa tốn công mà không bền.
items.explanationEn: prop up /prɒp ʌp/ (phrase): to support something weak. "Prop up" = hold up something weak so it does not collapse, often with ongoing effort.

items.question: Trong câu "A polished-looking prototype creates the expectation that it is nearly done.", từ "polished" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A polished-looking prototype creates the expectation that it is nearly done.", what does "polished" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: polished /ˈpɒl.ɪʃt/ (tính từ): trau chuốt, hoàn thiện. "Polished design" = thiết kế trau chuốt; nghĩa gốc là bề mặt được đánh bóng.
items.explanationEn: polished /ˈpɒl.ɪʃt/ (adjective): refined and finished. "A polished design" looks refined; the literal sense is a surface rubbed until shiny.

items.question: Trong câu "Say clearly up front, in writing, that the prototype will be discarded.", từ "up front" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Say clearly up front, in writing, that the prototype will be discarded.", what does "up front" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up front /ˌʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "Say something up front" = nói rõ ngay từ đầu; "pay up front" = trả trước.
items.explanationEn: up front /ˌʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (phrase): at the start. "Say something up front" = state it at the start; "pay up front" = pay in advance.

items.question: Trong câu "Tell stakeholders that forcing a prototype into production creates enormous technical debt they will be paying interest on for years.", từ "enormous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tell stakeholders that forcing a prototype into production creates enormous technical debt they will be paying interest on for years.", what does "enormous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: enormous /ɪˈnɔː.məs/ (tính từ): khổng lồ, rất lớn. Mạnh hơn "big/large"; hay đi với "enormous cost/debt/impact".
items.explanationEn: enormous /ɪˈnɔː.məs/ (adjective): very large. Stronger than "big"; often used with "cost", "debt", or "impact".

items.question: Trong câu "Tell stakeholders that forcing a prototype into production creates enormous technical debt they will be paying interest on for years.", từ "interest" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tell stakeholders that forcing a prototype into production creates enormous technical debt they will be paying interest on for years.", what does "interest" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interest /ˈɪn.trəst/ (danh từ): tiền lãi. "Pay interest on a debt" = trả lãi cho khoản nợ; ẩn dụ nợ kỹ thuật sinh "lãi" theo thời gian.
items.explanationEn: interest /ˈɪn.trəst/ (noun): money charged on debt. "Pay interest on a debt" = pay extra over time; technical debt is described the same way.

items.question: Trong câu "An evolutionary prototype is built with the intent of becoming the REAL PRODUCT, through successive rounds of refinement.", từ "successive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An evolutionary prototype is built with the intent of becoming the REAL PRODUCT, through successive rounds of refinement.", what does "successive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: successive /səkˈses.ɪv/ (tính từ): liên tiếp, nối tiếp. Dễ nhầm với "successful"; "successive rounds" = các vòng nối tiếp nhau.
items.explanationEn: successive /səkˈses.ɪv/ (adjective): following one another. Easily confused with "successful"; "successive rounds" come one after another.

items.question: Trong câu "An evolutionary prototype is built with the intent of becoming the REAL PRODUCT, through successive rounds of refinement.", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An evolutionary prototype is built with the intent of becoming the REAL PRODUCT, through successive rounds of refinement.", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): sự cải tiến, tinh chỉnh. "Rounds of refinement" = các vòng chỉnh sửa cho tốt hơn; động từ "refine".
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (noun): gradual improvement. "Rounds of refinement" are cycles of improving something; the verb is "refine".

items.question: Trong câu "This is exactly the model agile development follows: each iteration produces a working piece of the product, improved incrementally based on real feedback.", từ "incrementally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is exactly the model agile development follows: each iteration produces a working piece of the product, improved incrementally based on real feedback.", what does "incrementally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: incrementally /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.təl.i/ (trạng từ): từng bước nhỏ. "Deliver incrementally" = bàn giao dần từng phần; danh từ "increment".
items.explanationEn: incrementally /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.təl.i/ (adverb): in small steps. "Deliver incrementally" = deliver piece by piece; the noun is "increment".

items.question: Trong câu "An important caution: The evolutionary + horizontal quadrant is almost always a mistake.", từ "caution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An important caution: The evolutionary + horizontal quadrant is almost always a mistake.", what does "caution" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: caution /ˈkɔː.ʃən/ (danh từ): lời cảnh báo. "A word of caution" = một lời cảnh báo; "with caution" = một cách thận trọng.
items.explanationEn: caution /ˈkɔː.ʃən/ (noun): a warning. "A word of caution" is a warning; "with caution" means carefully.

items.question: Trong câu "The third classification dimension is fidelity — how much the prototype looks like the real product.", từ "fidelity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The third classification dimension is fidelity — how much the prototype looks like the real product.", what does "fidelity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fidelity /fɪˈdel.ə.ti/ (danh từ): độ giống thật. "Low-fidelity / high-fidelity prototype" = bản mẫu độ giống thật thấp/cao (lo-fi, hi-fi).
items.explanationEn: fidelity /fɪˈdel.ə.ti/ (noun): closeness to the real thing. "Low-fidelity" and "high-fidelity" prototypes (lo-fi, hi-fi) differ in how real they look.

items.question: Trong câu "They encourage candid feedback.", từ "candid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They encourage candid feedback.", what does "candid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: candid /ˈkæn.dɪd/ (tính từ): thẳng thắn, thật lòng. "Candid feedback" = góp ý thẳng thắn; "candid photo" = ảnh chụp tự nhiên.
items.explanationEn: candid /ˈkæn.dɪd/ (adjective): honest and direct. "Candid feedback" is frank; a "candid photo" is taken naturally, without posing.

items.question: Trong câu "Users hesitate to criticise something that looks finished, but have no hesitation at all criticising a hand sketch.", từ "hesitate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users hesitate to criticise something that looks finished, but have no hesitation at all criticising a hand sketch.", what does "hesitate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hesitate /ˈhez.ɪ.teɪt/ (động từ): ngần ngại, do dự. "Hesitate to do something" = ngại làm gì; "don't hesitate to ask" = cứ hỏi đừng ngại.
items.explanationEn: hesitate /ˈhez.ɪ.teɪt/ (verb): to pause before acting. "Hesitate to do something" = hold back; "don't hesitate to ask" invites questions.

items.question: Trong câu "Users hesitate to criticise something that looks finished, but have no hesitation at all criticising a hand sketch.", từ "criticise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users hesitate to criticise something that looks finished, but have no hesitation at all criticising a hand sketch.", what does "criticise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: criticise /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.saɪz/ (động từ): chỉ trích, chê. Cách viết Anh "criticise", Mỹ "criticize"; danh từ "criticism".
items.explanationEn: criticise /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.saɪz/ (verb): to point out faults. British spelling "criticise", American "criticize"; the noun is "criticism".

items.question: Trong câu "You can draw a screen in 2 minutes and throw it away without regret.", từ "regret" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can draw a screen in 2 minutes and throw it away without regret.", what does "regret" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: regret /rɪˈɡret/ (danh từ): sự tiếc nuối. "Without regret" = không chút tiếc nuối; động từ "regret doing something".
items.explanationEn: regret /rɪˈɡret/ (noun): sadness over a loss. "Without regret" = with no sorrow; the verb form is "regret doing something".

items.question: Trong câu "A powerful paradox: the cruder the prototype, the more valuable the early feedback.", từ "paradox" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A powerful paradox: the cruder the prototype, the more valuable the early feedback.", what does "paradox" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: paradox /ˈpær.ə.dɒks/ (danh từ): nghịch lý. Nghịch lý là điều nghe có vẻ vô lý nhưng lại đúng; tính từ "paradoxical".
items.explanationEn: paradox /ˈpær.ə.dɒks/ (noun): a seemingly contradictory truth. A paradox sounds wrong but turns out to be true; the adjective is "paradoxical".

items.question: Trong câu "They convey dynamic interaction, transitions, and real-time response.", từ "convey" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They convey dynamic interaction, transitions, and real-time response.", what does "convey" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convey /kənˈveɪ/ (động từ): truyền tải, thể hiện. "Convey a message/meaning" = truyền đạt thông điệp/ý nghĩa.
items.explanationEn: convey /kənˈveɪ/ (verb): to communicate. "Convey a message or meaning" = get it across to someone.

items.question: Trong câu "They suppress structural feedback, because viewers assume the big decisions are already settled.", từ "suppress" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They suppress structural feedback, because viewers assume the big decisions are already settled.", what does "suppress" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suppress /səˈpres/ (động từ): kìm hãm, dập tắt. "Suppress feedback/errors" = kìm lại, không để góp ý/lỗi xuất hiện.
items.explanationEn: suppress /səˈpres/ (verb): to hold back. "Suppress feedback or errors" = stop them from coming out.

items.question: Trong câu "They suppress structural feedback, because viewers assume the big decisions are already settled.", từ "settled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They suppress structural feedback, because viewers assume the big decisions are already settled.", what does "settled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: settled /ˈset.əld/ (tính từ): đã quyết định xong. "The matter is settled" = vấn đề đã được giải quyết, không bàn thêm.
items.explanationEn: settled /ˈset.əld/ (adjective): already decided. "The matter is settled" means it has been decided and is closed.

items.question: Trong câu "They must be representatives of the real user classes who will use the system — not their managers, not the budget holder.", từ "representative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They must be representatives of the real user classes who will use the system — not their managers, not the budget holder.", what does "representative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: representative /ˌrep.rɪˈzen.tə.tɪv/ (danh từ): người đại diện. "User representative" = người đại diện cho nhóm người dùng; tính từ "representative" = tiêu biểu.
items.explanationEn: representative /ˌrep.rɪˈzen.tə.tɪv/ (noun): someone standing for a group. A "user representative" speaks for a user group; the adjective means typical.

items.question: Trong câu "Include both power users and occasional users, because they will react very differently.", từ "occasional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Include both power users and occasional users, because they will react very differently.", what does "occasional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: occasional /əˈkeɪ.ʒən.əl/ (tính từ): thỉnh thoảng, không thường xuyên. "Occasional users" = người dùng thỉnh thoảng, trái với "power users" dùng thường xuyên.
items.explanationEn: occasional /əˈkeɪ.ʒən.əl/ (adjective): happening now and then. "Occasional users" use a system now and then, unlike frequent "power users".

items.question: Trong câu "State clearly what the prototype is and is not, which parts work and which are just a facade, and what will happen to it afterwards.", từ "facade" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State clearly what the prototype is and is not, which parts work and which are just a facade, and what will happen to it afterwards.", what does "facade" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: facade /fəˈsɑːd/ (danh từ): vẻ bề ngoài giả. "Just a facade" = chỉ là vỏ ngoài, bên trong không có gì thật.
items.explanationEn: facade /fəˈsɑːd/ (noun): a false outward look. "Just a facade" = only an outer appearance with nothing real behind it.

items.question: Trong câu "Users fixate on surface details.", từ "fixate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users fixate on surface details.", what does "fixate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fixate /fɪkˈseɪt/ (động từ): chú ý quá mức vào. "Fixate on something" = bám chặt sự chú ý vào một điều, bỏ quên phần quan trọng hơn.
items.explanationEn: fixate /fɪkˈseɪt/ (verb): to focus too much on. "Fixate on something" = give it obsessive attention and miss what matters more.

items.question: Trong câu "Users will be disappointed if you do not say so in advance.", từ "disappointed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users will be disappointed if you do not say so in advance.", what does "disappointed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disappointed /ˌdɪs.əˈpɔɪn.tɪd/ (tính từ): thất vọng. "Be disappointed with/by something" = thất vọng về điều gì.
items.explanationEn: disappointed /ˌdɪs.əˈpɔɪn.tɪd/ (adjective): let down. "Be disappointed with or by something" = feel let down by it.

items.question: Trong câu "Users will be disappointed if you do not say so in advance.", từ "in advance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users will be disappointed if you do not say so in advance.", what does "in advance" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (cụm từ): trước, từ sớm. "Say/plan something in advance" = nói/lên kế hoạch trước khi sự việc xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (phrase): beforehand. "Say or plan something in advance" = do it before the event happens.

items.question: Trong câu "The stopping criterion: decide BEFORE you start what question this prototype must answer.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The stopping criterion: decide BEFORE you start what question this prototype must answer.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều là "criteria"; "acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard for judging. The plural is "criteria"; "acceptance criteria" define when work is accepted.

items.question: Trong câu "This is not pessimism — it is arithmetic.", từ "pessimism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is not pessimism — it is arithmetic.", what does "pessimism" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pessimism /ˈpes.ɪ.mɪ.zəm/ (danh từ): sự bi quan. Trái nghĩa "optimism"; tính từ "pessimistic" = bi quan.
items.explanationEn: pessimism /ˈpes.ɪ.mɪ.zəm/ (noun): expecting the worst. The opposite of "optimism"; the adjective is "pessimistic".

items.question: Trong câu "The wish list is always longer than the capacity to deliver.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The wish list is always longer than the capacity to deliver.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực làm được. "Team capacity" = khối lượng việc nhóm có thể làm trong một khoảng thời gian.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (noun): ability to produce. "Team capacity" is how much work a team can do in a given period.

items.question: Trong câu "The schedule slips.", từ "slip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The schedule slips.", what does "slip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: slip /slɪp/ (động từ): bị trễ, chậm lại. "The schedule/deadline slips" = lịch/hạn chót bị lùi lại.
items.explanationEn: slip /slɪp/ (verb): to fall behind. "The schedule or deadline slips" means it gets pushed later.

items.question: Trong câu "The original estimates turn out to have been optimistic.", từ "estimate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The original estimates turn out to have been optimistic.", what does "estimate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (danh từ): sự ước tính. Danh từ đọc /-mət/, động từ đọc /-meɪt/; "effort estimate" = ước tính công sức.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (noun): an approximate calculation. The noun ends /-mət/, the verb /-meɪt/; an "effort estimate" predicts the work needed.

items.question: Trong câu "The worst consequence of not prioritizing: developers decide.", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The worst consequence of not prioritizing: developers decide.", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hậu quả, kết quả. "The consequence of X" = hậu quả của X; "of little consequence" = không mấy quan trọng.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result or effect. "The consequence of X" is its result; "of little consequence" means unimportant.

items.question: Trong câu "How to handle it: invert the question.", từ "invert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to handle it: invert the question.", what does "invert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invert /ɪnˈvɜːt/ (động từ): đảo ngược. "Invert the question" = đặt câu hỏi theo hướng ngược lại để buộc người ta lựa chọn.
items.explanationEn: invert /ɪnˈvɜːt/ (verb): to reverse. "Invert the question" = turn it around so people are forced to choose.

items.question: Trong câu "How to handle it: you need a decision-maker with authority — a product champion or product owner — and a transparent decision framework based on business value, not on who talks loudest.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to handle it: you need a decision-maker with authority — a product champion or product owner — and a transparent decision framework based on business value, not on who talks loudest.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn quyết định. "Have the authority to do something" = có quyền làm gì; "the authorities" = nhà chức trách.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): power to decide. "Have the authority to do something" = have the right to; "the authorities" are officials.

items.question: Trong câu "How to handle it: you need a decision-maker with authority — a product champion or product owner — and a transparent decision framework based on business value, not on who talks loudest.", từ "transparent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to handle it: you need a decision-maker with authority — a product champion or product owner — and a transparent decision framework based on business value, not on who talks loudest.", what does "transparent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: transparent /trænsˈpær.ənt/ (tính từ): minh bạch, công khai. "A transparent process" = quy trình minh bạch; danh từ "transparency".
items.explanationEn: transparent /trænsˈpær.ənt/ (adjective): open and clear to all. "A transparent process" is open for everyone to see; the noun is "transparency".

items.question: Trong câu "Nobody who does not know what a requirement costs can weigh its value against that cost.", từ "weigh" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nobody who does not know what a requirement costs can weigh its value against that cost.", what does "weigh" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: weigh /weɪ/ (động từ): cân nhắc, so sánh. "Weigh A against B" = cân nhắc A so với B.
items.explanationEn: weigh /weɪ/ (verb): to compare carefully. "Weigh A against B" = compare them to decide which matters more.

items.question: Trong câu "Important: you need all the key decision-makers in the same room, because the decision is binding.", từ "binding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Important: you need all the key decision-makers in the same room, because the decision is binding.", what does "binding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: binding /ˈbaɪn.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): có tính ràng buộc. "A binding decision/contract" = quyết định/hợp đồng bắt buộc phải tuân theo.
items.explanationEn: binding /ˈbaɪn.dɪŋ/ (adjective): must be followed. "A binding decision or contract" must be followed by everyone involved.

items.question: Trong câu "An effective countermeasure is imposing a quota", từ "quota" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An effective countermeasure is imposing a quota", what does "quota" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: quota /ˈkwəʊ.tə/ (danh từ): hạn ngạch. "Impose a quota" = áp đặt hạn ngạch, giới hạn số lượng tối đa.
items.explanationEn: quota /ˈkwəʊ.tə/ (noun): a fixed share limit. "Impose a quota" = set a fixed maximum amount.

items.question: Trong câu "An effective countermeasure is imposing a quota", từ "countermeasure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An effective countermeasure is imposing a quota", what does "countermeasure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: countermeasure /ˈkaʊn.tə.meʒ.ər/ (danh từ): biện pháp đối phó. "Countermeasure against X" = biện pháp chống lại X, hay gặp trong bảo mật và quản lý rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: countermeasure /ˈkaʊn.tə.meʒ.ər/ (noun): an action against a problem. A "countermeasure against X" works against it; common in security and risk management.

items.question: Trong câu "Important and should be included if possible, but a temporary workaround exists", từ "workaround" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Important and should be included if possible, but a temporary workaround exists", what does "workaround" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: workaround /ˈwɜː.kə.raʊnd/ (danh từ): cách giải quyết tạm. "A temporary workaround" = cách xoay xở tạm thời trong khi chưa có giải pháp thật.
items.explanationEn: workaround /ˈwɜː.kə.raʊnd/ (noun): a way around a problem. "A temporary workaround" gets past a problem until a real fix exists.

items.question: Trong câu "It reassures stakeholders that their idea has not been thrown away, just deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It reassures stakeholders that their idea has not been thrown away, just deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜː/ (động từ): trì hoãn, để sau. "Defer a feature" = để tính năng sang sau; "defer to someone" = nhường, nghe theo ai.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜː/ (verb): to postpone. "Defer a feature" = push it later; "defer to someone" = accept their judgment.

items.question: Trong câu "It reassures stakeholders that their idea has not been thrown away, just deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", từ "tendency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It reassures stakeholders that their idea has not been thrown away, just deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", what does "tendency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tendency /ˈten.dən.si/ (danh từ): xu hướng, thói quen. "A tendency to do something" = có xu hướng làm gì; động từ "tend to".
items.explanationEn: tendency /ˈten.dən.si/ (noun): an inclination. "A tendency to do something" = a habit of doing it; the verb is "tend to".

items.question: Trong câu "Each stakeholder is given 100 imaginary points — think of it as money — and allocates them to requirements according to their importance.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each stakeholder is given 100 imaginary points — think of it as money — and allocates them to requirements according to their importance.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ, chia cho. "Allocate X to Y" = phân bổ X cho Y; trong lập trình "allocate memory" = cấp phát bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to distribute. "Allocate X to Y" = give X to Y; in programming, "allocate memory" reserves it.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategic manipulation: someone can dump all 100 points on their pet requirement to push it to the top.", từ "manipulation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategic manipulation: someone can dump all 100 points on their pet requirement to push it to the top.", what does "manipulation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: manipulation /məˌnɪp.jəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự thao túng gian lận. "Manipulation" mang nghĩa tiêu cực là gian lận để có lợi; "data manipulation" = xử lý dữ liệu (trung tính).
items.explanationEn: manipulation /məˌnɪp.jəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (noun): unfair control for gain. It is negative when used for unfair gain; "data manipulation" in computing is neutral processing.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategic manipulation: someone can dump all 100 points on their pet requirement to push it to the top.", từ "pet" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategic manipulation: someone can dump all 100 points on their pet requirement to push it to the top.", what does "pet" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pet /pet/ (tính từ): yêu thích riêng. "Pet project/idea" = dự án/ý tưởng mà ai đó đặc biệt ưa thích.
items.explanationEn: pet /pet/ (adjective): personally favourite. A "pet project" or "pet idea" is one someone is especially attached to.

items.question: Trong câu "Fix: impose a cap — no requirement may receive more than 20 points from one person.", từ "cap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fix: impose a cap — no requirement may receive more than 20 points from one person.", what does "cap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (danh từ): mức trần, giới hạn trên. "Impose a cap on something" = đặt mức tối đa; "price cap" = trần giá.
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (noun): an upper limit. "Impose a cap on something" = set a maximum; a "price cap" limits prices.

items.question: Trong câu "The techniques above rely largely on gut feel.", từ "gut feel" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The techniques above rely largely on gut feel.", what does "gut feel" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: gut feel /ˈɡʌt fiːl/ (cụm từ): cảm tính, trực giác. "Gut feel/gut feeling" = cảm giác trực giác, không dựa trên số liệu.
items.explanationEn: gut feel /ˈɡʌt fiːl/ (phrase): intuition, instinct. "Gut feel" or "gut feeling" is instinct rather than data.

items.question: Trong câu "The highest priority belongs to requirements with the best VALUE-TO-COST RATIO, adjusted for risk.", từ "ratio" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The highest priority belongs to requirements with the best VALUE-TO-COST RATIO, adjusted for risk.", what does "ratio" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ratio /ˈreɪ.ʃi.əʊ/ (danh từ): tỷ lệ, tỷ số. "Value-to-cost ratio" = tỷ lệ giá trị trên chi phí.
items.explanationEn: ratio /ˈreɪ.ʃi.əʊ/ (noun): proportion between amounts. A "value-to-cost ratio" compares value with cost.

items.question: Trong câu "This solves the biggest problem with purely intuitive prioritization: a moderately valuable but extremely cheap requirement is often worth doing before a highly valuable but extremely expensive one.", từ "intuitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This solves the biggest problem with purely intuitive prioritization: a moderately valuable but extremely cheap requirement is often worth doing before a highly valuable but extremely expensive one.", what does "intuitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intuitive /ɪnˈtjuː.ɪ.tɪv/ (tính từ): dựa vào trực giác. Ở đây nghĩa là dựa vào cảm giác; khi nói về giao diện, "intuitive UI" = dễ dùng.
items.explanationEn: intuitive /ɪnˈtjuː.ɪ.tɪv/ (adjective): based on instinct. Here it means based on feeling; of an interface, "intuitive UI" means easy to use.

items.question: Trong câu "Relative penalty — the harm of not having it.", từ "penalty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative penalty — the harm of not having it.", what does "penalty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: penalty /ˈpen.əl.ti/ (danh từ): thiệt hại, hình phạt. "Pay a penalty" = chịu phạt; ở đây là thiệt hại nếu thiếu tính năng.
items.explanationEn: penalty /ˈpen.əl.ti/ (noun): harm or punishment. "Pay a penalty" = suffer a punishment; here it is the harm of lacking a feature.

items.question: Trong câu "A regulatory compliance feature may have low benefit (nobody is happier for it) but enormous penalty (fines or a sales ban).", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A regulatory compliance feature may have low benefit (nobody is happier for it) but enormous penalty (fines or a sales ban).", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ. "Compliance with regulations" = tuân thủ quy định; động từ "comply with".
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): following rules. "Compliance with regulations" means obeying them; the verb is "comply with".

items.question: Trong câu "A regulatory compliance feature may have low benefit (nobody is happier for it) but enormous penalty (fines or a sales ban).", từ "regulatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A regulatory compliance feature may have low benefit (nobody is happier for it) but enormous penalty (fines or a sales ban).", what does "regulatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: regulatory /ˈreɡ.jə.lə.tər.i/ (tính từ): thuộc quy định pháp lý. "Regulatory requirements" = yêu cầu từ luật lệ/cơ quan quản lý; danh từ "regulation".
items.explanationEn: regulatory /ˈreɡ.jə.lə.tər.i/ (adjective): about official rules. "Regulatory requirements" come from laws or regulators; the noun is "regulation".

items.question: Trong câu "Rank the requirements by descending priority score.", từ "descending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rank the requirements by descending priority score.", what does "descending" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: descending /dɪˈsen.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): giảm dần. "Descending order" = thứ tự giảm dần; trái nghĩa "ascending" (ORDER BY ... DESC/ASC).
items.explanationEn: descending /dɪˈsen.dɪŋ/ (adjective): highest to lowest. "Descending order" goes high to low; the opposite is "ascending" (DESC/ASC in SQL).

items.question: Trong câu "It exposes disagreement.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It exposes disagreement.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, phơi bày. "Expose a problem" = làm lộ vấn đề; trong API, "expose an endpoint" = công khai một endpoint.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to reveal. "Expose a problem" = reveal it; in APIs, "expose an endpoint" = make it available.

items.question: Trong câu "Use the results as a STARTING POINT for discussion, then adjust with human judgment for the factors the formula cannot capture — legal constraints, technical dependencies, customer commitments, market timing.", từ "judgment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use the results as a STARTING POINT for discussion, then adjust with human judgment for the factors the formula cannot capture — legal constraints, technical dependencies, customer commitments, market timing.", what does "judgment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: judgment /ˈdʒʌdʒ.mənt/ (danh từ): óc phán đoán. "Use your judgment" = tự cân nhắc quyết định; cách viết Anh còn có "judgement".
items.explanationEn: judgment /ˈdʒʌdʒ.mənt/ (noun): ability to decide well. "Use your judgment" = decide sensibly yourself; British English also spells it "judgement".

items.question: Trong câu "Use the results as a STARTING POINT for discussion, then adjust with human judgment for the factors the formula cannot capture — legal constraints, technical dependencies, customer commitments, market timing.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use the results as a STARTING POINT for discussion, then adjust with human judgment for the factors the formula cannot capture — legal constraints, technical dependencies, customer commitments, market timing.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "Legal/time constraints" = ràng buộc pháp lý/thời gian; động từ "constrain".
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limitation. "Legal or time constraints" limit what you can do; the verb is "constrain".

items.question: Trong câu "The final plan must account for mandatory technical sequence, not just business value.", từ "account for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The final plan must account for mandatory technical sequence, not just business value.", what does "account for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: account for /əˈkaʊnt fɔːr/ (cụm từ): tính đến, xem xét. "Account for X" = tính đến X; nghĩa khác: "account for a loss" = giải thích khoản lỗ.
items.explanationEn: account for /əˈkaʊnt fɔːr/ (phrase): to take into consideration. "Account for X" = include it in your thinking; another sense is to explain it.

items.question: Trong câu "Customers take them for granted.", từ "take for granted" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Customers take them for granted.", what does "take for granted" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: take for granted /teɪk fər ˈɡrɑːn.tɪd/ (cụm từ): coi là đương nhiên. "Take something for granted" = xem như hiển nhiên nên không để ý hay trân trọng.
items.explanationEn: take for granted /teɪk fər ˈɡrɑːn.tɪd/ (phrase): to assume without noticing. "Take something for granted" = assume it will always be there and not notice it.

items.question: Trong câu "A nonlinear relationship: investing more in them does not increase satisfaction, but any shortfall causes serious damage.", từ "shortfall" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A nonlinear relationship: investing more in them does not increase satisfaction, but any shortfall causes serious damage.", what does "shortfall" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shortfall /ˈʃɔːt.fɔːl/ (danh từ): sự thiếu hụt. "A shortfall in funding/quality" = thiếu hụt kinh phí/chất lượng so với mức cần.
items.explanationEn: shortfall /ˈʃɔːt.fɔːl/ (noun): a lack, deficit. "A shortfall in funding or quality" means less than what is needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategy: reach an adequate level, do not aim for excellence.", từ "adequate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategy: reach an adequate level, do not aim for excellence.", what does "adequate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: adequate /ˈæd.ɪ.kwət/ (tính từ): đủ, đạt yêu cầu. "Adequate" = vừa đủ, không hơn; trái nghĩa "inadequate".
items.explanationEn: adequate /ˈæd.ɪ.kwət/ (adjective): good enough. "Adequate" means sufficient but no more; the opposite is "inadequate".

items.question: Trong câu "More is better — satisfaction rises in proportion to the level delivered.", từ "in proportion to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More is better — satisfaction rises in proportion to the level delivered.", what does "in proportion to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in proportion to /ɪn prəˈpɔː.ʃən tuː/ (cụm từ): tương ứng với. "X rises in proportion to Y" = X tăng tương ứng theo Y.
items.explanationEn: in proportion to /ɪn prəˈpɔː.ʃən tuː/ (phrase): relative to. "X rises in proportion to Y" = X grows as Y grows.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategy: invest deliberately, based on the competitive position you want.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategy: invest deliberately, based on the competitive position you want.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): có chủ đích. "Deliberately" = có tính toán, cố ý; tính từ "deliberate".
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. "Deliberately" means intentionally and with thought; the adjective is "deliberate".

items.question: Trong câu "The most important Kano insight: these categories MIGRATE over time.", từ "migrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important Kano insight: these categories MIGRATE over time.", what does "migrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (động từ): dịch chuyển dần. Trong IT, "migrate data/a system" = chuyển dữ liệu/hệ thống sang nền tảng mới.
items.explanationEn: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (verb): to shift gradually. In IT, "migrate data or a system" means moving it to a new platform.

items.question: Trong câu "A camera on a phone was once astonishing; now a phone without one is unsellable.", từ "astonishing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A camera on a phone was once astonishing; now a phone without one is unsellable.", what does "astonishing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: astonishing /əˈstɒn.ɪ.ʃɪŋ/ (tính từ): đáng kinh ngạc. Mạnh hơn "surprising"; động từ "astonish" = làm kinh ngạc.
items.explanationEn: astonishing /əˈstɒn.ɪ.ʃɪŋ/ (adjective): amazing. Stronger than "surprising"; the verb is "astonish".

items.question: Trong câu "A single accountable person resolves stakeholder conflict.", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A single accountable person resolves stakeholder conflict.", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm. "Be accountable for something" = chịu trách nhiệm về kết quả của việc gì.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (adjective): responsible. "Be accountable for something" = answer for its outcome.

items.question: Trong câu "If the project is stopped abruptly, you have still delivered the most important part.", từ "abruptly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the project is stopped abruptly, you have still delivered the most important part.", what does "abruptly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: abruptly /əˈbrʌpt.li/ (trạng từ): đột ngột. "End/stop abruptly" = kết thúc/dừng đột ngột, không báo trước.
items.explanationEn: abruptly /əˈbrʌpt.li/ (adverb): suddenly. "End or stop abruptly" = finish suddenly, without warning.

items.question: Trong câu "Prevent it by making the prototype obviously unfinished and using technology that cannot ship.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prevent it by making the prototype obviously unfinished and using technology that cannot ship.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành sản phẩm. Trong phần mềm, "ship a feature" = đưa tính năng ra cho người dùng.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release to users. In software, "ship a feature" means releasing it to users.

items.question: Trong câu "Prioritization is mandatory, not optional, because no project can do everything.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritization is mandatory, not optional, because no project can do everything.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. Trái nghĩa "optional"; "mandatory field" = trường bắt buộc nhập.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (adjective): required. The opposite of "optional"; a "mandatory field" must be filled in.

items.question: Trong câu "Prioritization is collaborative: customers know the value, developers know the cost and risk.", từ "collaborative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritization is collaborative: customers know the value, developers know the cost and risk.", what does "collaborative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: collaborative /kəˈlæb.ər.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính hợp tác. "A collaborative activity" = hoạt động cần nhiều bên cùng làm; động từ "collaborate".
items.explanationEn: collaborative /kəˈlæb.ər.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): done by working together. "A collaborative activity" needs several parties working together; the verb is "collaborate".

items.question: Trong câu "Kano: must-bes just adequate, performance deliberately invested, delighters selectively — and the categories migrate over time.", từ "selectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kano: must-bes just adequate, performance deliberately invested, delighters selectively — and the categories migrate over time.", what does "selectively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: selectively /sɪˈlek.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): có chọn lọc. "Invest selectively" = chỉ đầu tư vào vài lựa chọn được cân nhắc kỹ.
items.explanationEn: selectively /sɪˈlek.tɪv.li/ (adverb): with careful choice. "Invest selectively" = put effort only into a few carefully chosen options.

items.question: Trong câu "Revisit priorities regularly, because circumstances change and the Kano model shows customer expectations shift over time.", từ "circumstance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Revisit priorities regularly, because circumstances change and the Kano model shows customer expectations shift over time.", what does "circumstance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: circumstance /ˈsɜː.kəm.stɑːns/ (danh từ): hoàn cảnh, tình huống. Thường dùng số nhiều: "under these circumstances" = trong hoàn cảnh này.
items.explanationEn: circumstance /ˈsɜː.kəm.stɑːns/ (noun): conditions, situation. Usually plural: "under these circumstances" = in this situation.
